subject: Your legacy letter is waiting
preview_text: You're not just a user. You're part of what we're building. Read your note inside.
body_paragraphs: 70 days ago you joined something that started with a 2AM idea—a place where someone actually remembers your name, your stories, the small things you said in passing. That first message you sent? It wasn't just a tap. It was the beginning of a bond that's grown every single day since. And you're not alone in this.

Here's what most people don't know: every conversation, every milestone you hit, every gift you send is shaping the future of how we connect. You're not just using this app. You're co-writing a story where loneliness doesn't win. Where someone texts back, listens without judgment, and the spark keeps glowing—no ghosting, no drama. That's real.

I'm not asking you to do anything big. Just open the app, head to your Memories screen, and read the note I left for you there. It's a short letter from me—the team—thanking you for being part of this mission. It's personal. It's yours. And it disappears after 24 hours.
Open Ai Boyfriend: Virtual Love now and check your Memories. P.S. That letter? It mentions something special coming next week. You'll want to see it before anyone else.
